_comment: Was DESTROY_TOKEN, which destroys ONE token of a named slug that the CONTROLLER controls. 'destroy ALL aura TOKENS they control' -- all three of those (count, token-only, opponent) were unreachable through DESTROY_TOKEN. Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
